fault_location: axis-2 planetary-gear tooth surfaces meshing with the central-axis gear
physics_prior_method: encoder-angle resampling to the motor-order domain; finite-band energies at three harmonics of RV planetary/mesh/sideband orders plus harmonic ratios and impulsiveness
vibration_preprocessing: The supplied _cleaned files retain every 10th raw sample index: 10 kHz raw rate and 1 kHz effective rate. The anti-alias filter/cutoff must still be reported from the preprocessing record.
parameter_source: Nabtesco RV-E official catalogue for RV-40E-121 reducer constants; HINITECH HN8G official manual plus the photographed axis-2 nameplate for servo constants; Han et al. (Energies 2024, 17, 1178) for the admissible RV mesh-damping-ratio range used only to form a nominal damping estimate.

parameter_notes.motor_inertia_kg_m2: The exact BRT-custom 1.7 kW row is absent from the public table. The adopted 8.7e-4 kg*m^2 is the with-brake value for the same HN8G medium-inertia, 130-mm-flange, 3000-rpm family adjacent 1.5/2.0 kW models. Treat it as a manufacturer-family proxy and include Jm sensitivity; do not present it as an exact nameplate value.
parameter_notes.torsional_damping_Nm_s_per_rad: This is not an experimental identification. It is the output-side nominal value computed with zeta=0.05, within the published RV mesh-damping-ratio range 0.03-0.17. Report the formula and a sensitivity interval; replace it if a joint-2 free-decay/FRF identification becomes available.
parameter_notes.encoder_scaling: axis-1 originates from the motor encoder but the numeric export is controller-scaled to joint/output-equivalent degrees. Across all 60 source trials, abs(d(axis-1)/dt)*121/6 has median correlation 0.9798 with curSpeed-1 and median predicted/measured ratio 1.0124.
parameter_notes.torque_reference_frame: The observed 0..4230 values, absence of negative samples, and BORUNTE convention 2580=1x rated torque support an unsigned motor-side normalized servo-torque field, not direct N*m. Conversion is curTorque*5.4/2580 N*m; the observed maximum becomes 8.8535 N*m (1.6395x rated), physically plausible for the servo/reducer.
parameter_notes.fault_location: All four seeded faults are on axis-2 RV-reducer gears; the manuscript currently specifies the planetary-gear tooth surfaces meshing with the central-axis gear.
parameter_notes.torque_limit_interpretation: 2058 N*m is the momentary maximum allowable torque, not the continuous rated torque.
